SELECT i.id, COALESCE(i.title_zh, i.title_original) AS title, i.participation_status AS participationStatus, i.difficulty, i.github_updated_at AS githubUpdatedAt FROM open_source_issue i JOIN open_source_repository r ON r.id = i.repository_id WHERE i.state = 'open' AND r.enabled = 1 AND i.visibility_status IN ('LEGACY_VISIBLE', 'PUBLIC') ORDER BY FIELD(i.participation_status, 'TRY', 'POSSIBLY_CLAIMED', 'NOT_RECOMMENDED'), i.github_updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM open_source_issue i JOIN open_source_repository r ON r.id = i.repository_id WHERE i.state = 'open' AND r.enabled = 1 ORDER BY FIELD(i.verification_status, 'PENDING', 'FAILED', 'DONE'), i.verified_at ASC, i.github_updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM open_source_issue i JOIN open_source_repository r ON r.id = i.repository_id WHERE i.state = 'open' AND i.translation_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') ORDER BY i.github_updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE open_source_issue SET title_zh = #{titleZh}, summary_zh = #{summaryZh}, translation_status = #{status}, translated_at = IF(#{status} = 'DONE', NOW(), translated_at), translation_attempts = translation_attempts + 1, translation_error = #{error}, visibility_status = CASE WHEN visibility_status = 'LEGACY_VISIBLE' THEN visibility_status WHEN #{status} = 'DONE' AND verification_status = 'DONE' AND state = 'open' THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE 'PENDING' END, published = CASE WHEN visibility_status = 'LEGACY_VISIBLE' THEN published WHEN #{status} = 'DONE' AND verification_status = 'DONE' AND state = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE open_source_issue SET state = #{state}, comments_count = #{commentsCount}, assignees_json = CAST(#{assigneesJson} AS JSON), linked_pr_count = #{linkedPrCount}, claim_status = #{claimStatus}, participation_status = #{participationStatus}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, risk_flags_json = CAST(#{riskFlagsJson} AS JSON), github_updated_at = #{githubUpdatedAt}, verified_at = NOW(), verification_status = 'DONE', visibility_status = CASE WHEN #{state} != 'open' OR #{linkedPrCount} > 0 OR #{claimStatus} = 'CLAIMED' THEN 'HIDDEN' WHEN visibility_status = 'LEGACY_VISIBLE' THEN 'LEGACY_VISIBLE' WHEN translation_status = 'DONE' THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE 'PENDING' END, published = CASE WHEN #{state} != 'open' OR #{linkedPrCount} > 0 OR #{claimStatus} = 'CLAIMED' THEN 0 WHEN visibility_status = 'LEGACY_VISIBLE' THEN 1 WHEN translation_status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN published = 1 AND state = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS published, SUM(CASE WHEN translation_status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS translated, SUM(CASE WHEN translation_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS translationPending, MAX(verified_at) AS lastVerifiedAt FROM open_source_issue
mapper.update: UPDATE open_source_issue SET title_zh = #{titleZh}, summary_zh = #{summaryZh}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, participation_status = #{participationStatus}, published = #{published}, translation_status = CASE WHEN #{titleZh} IS NOT NULL AND #{summaryZh} IS NOT NULL THEN 'DONE' ELSE translation_status END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO open_source_guide (account_id, issue_id, content, segment_cost) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{issueId}, #{content}, #{segmentCost}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), content = VALUES(content), segment_cost = VALUES(segment_cost), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.issue_id AS issueId, g.content, g.segment_cost AS segmentCost, g.create_time AS createTime, g.update_time AS updateTime, COALESCE(i.title_zh, i.title_original) AS issueTitle, i.html_url AS issueUrl, r.full_name AS repositoryFullName FROM open_source_guide g JOIN open_source_issue i ON i.id = g.issue_id JOIN open_source_repository r ON r.id = i.repository_id WHERE g.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY g.update_time DESC

SELECT g.id, g.issue_id AS issueId, g.content, g.segment_cost AS segmentCost, g.create_time AS createTime, g.update_time AS updateTime, COALESCE(i.title_zh, i.title_original) AS issueTitle, i.html_url AS issueUrl, r.full_name AS repositoryFullName FROM open_source_guide g JOIN open_source_issue i ON i.id = g.issue_id JOIN open_source_repository r ON r.id = i.repository_id WHERE g.id = #{id} AND g.account_id = #{accountId}
